function detectLangFromPath(pathname): string

Defined in: core/i18n.ts:109

Extracts the locale segment from a URL path; defaults to English when the first segment isn't a valid locale code. /de/ueber → 'de', /about → 'en' (English is the un-prefixed default).

Parameters

pathname

string

location.pathname

Returns

string

locale code from LOCALES
